newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Feb 6.

text.p: Sumitomo Metal Mining Co Ltd, Sumitomo Corp and a leading U.S. copper producer plan to spend 40 billion yen on copper production in Chile. They hope to increase annual production by more than 60 percent to 665,000 tonnes by mid-1998. The Ex-Im Bank of Japan and five other Japanese banks will also invest in the project.
Toyoda Automatic Loom Works Ltd and Texas Instruments Inc have dropped a plan to set up a joint venture to produce dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips due to a slump in the market.

Toyota Motor Corp is expected to see an operating loss of more than 40 billion yen due to the weekend fire at a key parts supplier. Toyota may not be able to make up the 60,000 to 70,000 units of lost production by the end of March.

Nishimatsu Construction Co Ltd is expected to see its pre-tax profit fall eight percent year on year to around 30 billion yen in the business year to March 31, its first yearly profit fall in 10 years, This is due to worsened profitability in condominium construction. The firm may also have appraisal losses due to the sharp decline in stock prices.
